svg.text: every component above is spliced verbatim from a gated trace; the XML comment over each one names the trace and the translate
Gold is three tiers, not one: bright bars and tabs #f5c379 / #f0bf7b, mid text cores and veneer
grain #c19867, dark outlines and strands #c5965a, over a glow family #38261a / #39281b / #3b2416 /
#351b11 that is as much ink as the gold.
shared haze cx 712.8 cy -61.2 r 1015.8, y radius 393.6, rotate 1.76; stops 0 #7a538b, 0.2 #5e4169,
0. Blue annulus cx 765.3 cy -316.3, radii 1188.4 / 800, rotate 10; #21364e at .68 under a left fading
luminance mask. Clear source patches match on all four screens; grain and local light remain source residue.
The field here is translated +160 in x for the wider sheet.
PHOTO RESIDUE, do not draw: each trace lays a blurred copy of its content under the crisp content,
filter #halo blur 1.5 x 4.5 for strokes and #halotext 1.0 x 1.6 for glyphs, tagged class=photo.
That is the photograph's bloom. This sheet omits it.

1 There is NO device frame. The chrome is the stacked hairline wire band: parallel strands on low
runs rising through mirrored S bends onto ONE high line. Store 8 at 3.2 pitch, bridge y 124.2; hub and
mail 8 converging to y 87; login 22 as a trapezoid across the foot. Both ends curl down into a
2 Corners are cut per widget, never by one rule: cascade card 42.5 top right and a 45 degree foot
diagonal; detail panel a stepped top (S-curve rising 30 over 46, r7.5 / r10); store card r13 top left,
37 degree step, r18 top right, r8 bottom right, bottom left cut 19x22; nav and RIFLES buttons r4 / r5
with a 15x11.6 / 13x10 bottom left cut; mail selection 22 top right; CTA 16x13 bottom left.
3 Selection is a MATERIAL: a veneer base fill plus wavy grain hairlines (mail 1.7 pitch #cf975c, SMG
2.1 #d0975a, card 2 2.4 #cd9553, basket 2.1 #c9844c), a vertical book match seam at the plate's
midpoint, arcs into the chamfer and a swirl at the leading edge.
4 Outlines come in onion layers: hub cards carry 6 and the detail panel 4 echo outlines nested INSIDE,
sharing the left edge, 3 to 3.7 pitch, 0.85 (panel 0.70) down to 0.25; store cards carry 5 echo strands
at 3.2 high-edge pitch, 0.55 down to 0.18, round the shoulder, top right, right side and bottom, dying on the bottom
left cut. The SELECTED item carries none.
5 Every outlined button and every list rule wears a filled trapezoid tab on its bottom edge, inside
the stroke: mail RIFLES 37/29/7 #fdcf8c, store nav 31/36.5/5.1 #f7cc8c, list rules 31/24/5, card foot
6 Boxed letters A B C D are 26x26 r3 plates with a folded bottom right corner, beside the band and in
the foot, each with a two line SPARE TIME MANAGER annotation. On the band their interior is filled
7 Dark on gold is a mid brown, never black: #3a2010 store, #5a3418 basket, #6b3f1e CTA, and #7b5438 /
#895f3b / #865c39 on the mail veneer, lighter again. Solid gold bars with a bottom left cut are the
8 Product cards name themselves at the FOOT, with a tab under the bottom edge; hub cards label at the
upper left, outside the card. The T2 badge is outlined, not filled. The message pane has no panel at
Screen-specific drawing tables carry the traces; Chrome::DeviceFrame remains in the bar mail example.
Corner::ClipTopRight { cut: 30.0 } is still a generic fallback; sourced widgets cut per screen.
No source screen has a full device frame or a universal 30px top-right cut.
border FRAME #916424 is sampled by nothing. Outlines run #dab176 / #c5965a / #bd8951 / #e0b67a / #a97c48;
FRAME_LIT #c69a55 is the nearest const, as bar.svg records.
STRATA #634427, 'fine lines of a strata divider bunching into a wedge': no trace has one. The era's
layered fine lines are the wire band and the onion rings.
FIELD #2c1c14 vs the measured field #3c1c11; VENEER #e3af5f vs bases #f8c678 / #f4c078 / #f6c27a;
GOLD_TEXT #e7c686 vs cores #f5bf75 / #f3c583 / #e9bd7a. AMBER #fcc474 does agree with the CTA bar
Trace mail ink #7b5438 / #895f3b / #865c39 now prints separately on the selected runtime row;
custom palettes retain their on_select role. Native photo still carries darker grain and soft glow.
Ground::Bloom is the generic fallback. All four screen Prim tables use the same fitted haze;
the bar uses the dashboard field by design. Source grain and local light remain outside this fit.
Typography and photographed veneer refinement remain NK-05 / NK-07; see component-sync.md.
11 HOVER AND PRESS . REST / HOVER / PRESS, ONE ELEMENT PER COLUMN

hover = ECHO: the cell's edge repeats outward as seven fading hairlines using the retained inferred convention (#a97c48 0.7, opacity 0.85 to 0.55, each ring 2.1 up / 1.6 right / 0.6 left / 0.3 down), nothing else moves
press = VENEER: the cell's sourced selected look, spliced verbatim (base + grain + seam, outline and rings gone, tab kept, dark ink); a press that selects just stays selected
the run shows no pointer and no lit sibling anywhere (nine stills, four masters), so every HOVER and the field's FOCUS below is INFERRED; every REST and every PRESS is a sourced state

fanning 2.1 up / 1.6 right per ring; face, tab and label unchanged
